filename: Anthem of the Esperanto Movement "La Espero".mp3
title: La Espero
author: L. L. Zamenhof
description: The anthem of the Esperanto movement, written by its creator L. L. Zamenhof in 1887. It expresses hope for a united humanity speaking a common language.

filename: Ho, Mia Kor' (＂Oh, My Heart＂) (2021) for soprano and piano [flute demo].mp3
title: Ho, Mia Kor'
author: L. L. Zamenhof
description: One of Zamenhof's earliest poems, set to music. This 2021 recording features soprano and piano with a flute demo. The poem speaks of the restless human heart yearning for peace.

title: Velkoj
author: William Auld
description: William Auld was a Scottish poet who wrote almost exclusively in Esperanto and was nominated for the Nobel Prize in Literature. Velkoj is one of his celebrated works.

title: Krawężniki Splendoru #3 — Ludwik Łazarz Zamenhof
author: L. L. Zamenhof
description: An episode from the Krawężniki Splendoru series about the life and legacy of Ludwik Łazarz Zamenhof, creator of Esperanto, from Białystok, Poland.
